none: PAS FindID 985145: Roman Coin: Denarius, possibly of Commodus
contea di ritrovamento: North Lincolnshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

Silver coin. Denarius, possibly of Commodus (175-192), though not found in Sear; abraded. Obverse description: Bust laureate right, bearded, with tight curls on the head. Obverse inscription: [---] IMP. Reverse description: Hercules standing right with bow in his left hand, propped club held in right. Reverse inscription: [---] AVG. Diameter: 17.3mm, Weight: 1.93gms, die axis: 12
